teaser: A proposed design for billing on vaults: the user's browser keeps the meter, credit now and validated later, one light check at the server.
core_idea: User management, activity and billing can move to the client: each user has a billing vault where their browser appends signed activity and adds credit as soon as they pay, while the admin side later checks payments with Stripe and commits signed validations, so the product keeps working on unvalidated credit and the one remaining server only checks a valid key and a cached signed credit.

quotes.text: A user very rarely runs several clients at the same time.
The product keeps working, and the credit simply moves from unvalidated to validated.
